name: Open settings and land on notifications
description: Navigate from the app home screen to the settings panel and open the notifications section.
setup_instructions: Assume the user is already signed in.
failure_criteria: The agent loops without reaching settings.
grader_notes: For a live adapter, verify the notifications section is actually visible.
optional_cleanup_steps: Close the settings panel if it remains open.

adapter_config.initial_state_summary: Home dashboard is visible with a top-right profile menu.
adapter_config.completion_state_summary: Settings is open and the Notifications section is active.

steps.resulting_state_summary: The profile menu is open with entries for Settings, Billing, and Sign out.
The settings panel is open with tabs for General, Notifications, and Security.
Notifications settings are visible with email and desktop toggles.
